C3-01-L07 - Retries, backoff, jitter and transient failures
Focused effort: 3.0 h | Matching practice P07 | Overlap: deeper engineering progression
Retrying can improve reliability or amplify an outage. The difference is whether you retry only transient failures, cap
attempts, spread clients with jitter and keep the operation safe to repeat.

NEW WORDS BEFORE WE USE THEM
transient - Failure likely to clear without changing the request, e.g. temporary 503/network issue.
backoff - Increasing delay between retry attempts.
jitter - Random variation added to retry delay to reduce synchronized retry storms.
idempotence - Repeating an operation produces no unintended additional effect.
